artifact_digest_origin: reused v626 baseline inventory, not recomputed in this task
scope: Static source and targeted smali verification of Remote browsing sidebar owner. No implementation edits, original-app runtime or device operations.

findings.conclusion: Browsing header sidebar action toggles remembered scaffold state. Mapping this action to Activity.finish is incorrect.
Official Remote owns a scaffold sidebar state and reuses ConversationSidebar content and workspace dependencies. A single app-global drawer state has not been proven.
Explicit external Function2 header slot can intentionally render a BackButton for another navigation entry. Preserve the distinction between main browsing entry and nested entry.

host_recommendation.decision: Embed normal Remote list route inside existing AppShell drawer ownership and reuse existing sidebar content, provided its state holder can retain remote filters, scroll, draft and task selection. Keep standalone/deep-link activity as an adapter to that route if required.
host_recommendation.reason: The independent host already has a main sidebar implementation. Reusing it matches the observed sidebar-content reuse and avoids duplicating sidebar items/settings/navigation. This is an engineering mapping, not a recovered claim of one global official owner.
navigation_rules: Opening sidebar only changes drawer state; keep Remote route, task identity, filters, list position and draft mounted or saved.
Selecting a sidebar route closes drawer and dispatches actual route choice. Re-selecting Remote preserves its per-route state.
System Back first closes open drawer, then exits search/composing/detail in the supported route scope; do not bind toolbar menu to finish.
Nested Remote entries may retain explicit BackButton semantics; default browsing entry uses sidebar callback.
validation: Launch from home sidebar into Remote; left control opens same sidebar.
Close via scrim or system Back; Remote list position/filter/draft remains.
Switch sidebar Chat to Remote and verify scoped drafts and list position.
Main toolbar menu never returns to launcher.
Search and composing branches maintain their independent cancel/back semantics.

unknowns: Full official workspace sidebar navigation and every route retention policy not exhaustively traced.
Exact restore behavior across process death and account/workspace switch not established by this bounded chain.
Remote scaffold z/z2 gate truth table not fully decoded.
Visual drawer motion, dimensions and screenshot parity require parent validation.
